newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber up fresh enquiries.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber up fresh enquiries.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices edged higher in late trading on Tuesday following fresh U.S. and Singapore enquiries, dealers said.
"Overall market sentiment is firming up, with some sellers seen raising their offer prices further to break the psychological barrier of 56.00 cents," one Medan dealer said.

Dealers said February/March SIR20 offer prices edged higher by 0.25 U.S. cents/lb to 55.75-56.25 fob Medan, 55.50-55.75 fob Surabaya, Padang and Palembang as well as 55.00-55.25 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
February/March SIR20 was last bought at 55.50 fob Medan and Palembang and at 55.25 fob Padang by United States and Singaporean firms late on Monday.
